If Smallpox plays a Psyche at superior , then is the next round of
combat qualify for her special of "consecutive rounds"?

Messages.Author: Odrich Wendergass
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
> If Smallpox plays a Psyche at superior , then is the next round of
> combat qualify for her special of "consecutive rounds"?
>

While IANLSJ, I'd say no, given that Psyche! at [CEL] starts a new
combat. It does not press for another round.

If LSJ says otherwise, then it wouldn't be different from untapping her
and rushing the same minion with another card.

She's a beaut, isn't she? I mean, behind all that red stuff covering
her face...

OW

Messages.Author: obelisk
Messages.Body:


Ability: If Smallpox successfully inflicts hand damage in consecutive
rounds of a combat, the opponent gets a pox counter.

Psyche
Card Text:

Press.

Only usable at the end of a combat when both combatants are still
ready. Enter combat with the opposing minion. This is a new combat.

This is a new combat, so, in a word, no.

~m
